title: Peanut Tofu Jungle Noodles
subtitle: with Pak Choy and Fried Shallots
description: It’s plant power all the way with our super-tasty vegan dishes! Our meat-free, dairy-free, honey-free dishes are amped with plant-based proteins, fresh produce, nuts and seeds. Best of all, they’re for everyone, whether you're vegan, vegetarian or flexitarian.

steps.text: Prep ingredients: Thinly slice the onion. Halve the carrot lengthwise, then thinly slice. Trim the pak choy and separate the leaves. Cut the tofu into 2cm cubes (see Cooking tip). Put 1 tbs plain flour in a large bowl, add the tofu and toss to coat. Bring a medium saucepan of water to the boil for the noodles.

Pan-fry tofu: Heat 1½ tbs vegetable oil in a medium deep frypan over medium-high heat. Cook the tofu for 2 mins each side or until crisp and golden. Remove from the pan, drain on paper towel and season with salt. Wipe the pan clean. Heat 2 tsp vegetable oil in the pan over medium-high heat. Cook the onion and carrot, stirring, for 3-4 mins until softened.

Cook veggies: Add the red galangal seasoning to the veggies and cook, stirring, for 30 secs or until fragrant. Stir in 1 tsp white vinegar, 1 tsp soy sauce and 180ml (¾ cup) water and bring to a simmer. Reduce the heat to medium and cook, stirring, for 2 mins or until the veggies are tender and the sauce is slightly thickened.

Cook noodles and pak choy: Meanwhile, cook the noodles in the pan of boiling water for 6 mins. Add the pak choy and cook for a further 1 min or until the noodles and pak choy are tender. Drain, then rinse under hot water to prevent the noodles from sticking.

Serve up: Add the noodles and pak choy to the veggies and cook, stirring, for 1 min or until combined. Taste, then season with salt and pepper. Divide the jungle noodles and tofu among bowls, scatter with the fried shallots and ¼ tsp chilli flakes, if using, and enjoy!
Make it herby: If you have some on hand, scatter over a handful of mint or coriander leaves for a burst of freshness.
